definition: Creation-dissolution play — the world's creation (sṛṣṭi) and dissolution (saṃhāra) as Śiva's play (līlā). Not serious work but spontaneous play; the world arises and subsides within Śiva without affecting his nature.

sources.claim: prathayati ca vicitrāḥ sṛṣṭisaṃhāralīlāḥ (and displays various creation-dissolution plays)

translations.note: 'Play' (līlā) is the key — the world is not serious work but spontaneous play.
